e39856ab6637: What is travel agency management software?
fe6921d988ee: Travel agency management software is a tool that centralizes the entire sales cycle of a travel booking file: booking, quote, order, invoice, customer payment, supplier purchase and accounting. Travelife Manage is an example designed specifically for tourism.
9e12e39e78e8: Unlike standard invoicing software, it handles industry-specific services (flights, hotels, transfers, tours, visas), connects to GDSs and suppliers via API, and calculates VAT on margin. Each transaction is entered only once and automatically feeds reports and accounting.
1b6e7cb6ce46: How much does Travelife travel agency management software cost?
afd95fccd7b4: Travelife travel agency management software starts at 199 € per month with the Travelife ERP Core plan (5 users included, 1,500 € setup fee), which covers quotes, orders, customer and supplier invoicing, payments, cash management, margin tracking, CRM, multi-currency and VAT on margin.
a34f4aca50b6: The Business (399 €/month, 10 users) and Connect (599 €/month, 20 users) plans add the catalog, hotel contracts, booking engine and GDS / API connections. Travelife takes no commission on your sales. Details on the pricing page.
cad812e1e46c: Does Travelife travel agency management software handle VAT on margin?
1bb04bc787b1: Yes. Travelife Manage applies the VAT rules specific to travel agencies and automatically calculates VAT on margin based on the selling price and supplier costs of each booking file.
4fd2460c42e5: Invoices are generated directly from the booking engines, with automatic service fee calculation, and every invoicing transaction immediately updates the accounting module. This eliminates manual calculation errors and secures your tax compliance.
d05daffeded7: Can my external accountant access the software?
57cf1fe86bc4: Yes. Since Travelife is 100% cloud, your external accountant can view your data online without visiting your agency, with access limited to the information they need.
5babdc928264: With accounts kept up to date in real time, they can quickly identify files that need further checking and close accounting periods without wasting time.
d7076c767607: Can I restrict each employee’s access to certain information?
1079fc37bc76: Yes. Access to Travelife Manage can be tailored to each person’s responsibilities and the confidentiality of your agency’s information: each user has a profile with their own permissions.
9645f5f364a8: An agent can track their revenue and profits in real time over a given period, while the agency manager views the performance of each agent, or of all their agencies if they run several.
1c4a0b3b6963: Can the travel agency management software be funded by the GO SIYAHA program?
e3e23cb8141e: Yes. Travelife is listed with Maroc PME under the GO SIYAHA program, dedicated to the digital transformation of travel agencies in Morocco. The travel agency management software is one of the eligible solutions, with funding of up to 90%.
77cdeb7545ca: The B2C website, B2B booking platform, digital marketing support and SmartCRM are also eligible. Check your agency’s eligibility.
